PLAN "Perimenopause Strength: Bone-Loading Compound Focus (Start 2026-06-01)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Bone density and muscle maintenance via compound lifts"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation Strength and Tolerance" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower A: Squat Pattern + Posterior Chain":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3 rpe 6..7 rest 180 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          leg_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          calf_raise 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper A: Press + Row":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 6..7 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 6m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Lower B: Hinge + Single-Leg":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 5x3 rpe 6..7 rest 180 seconds
          front_squat 4x5 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          split_squat 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          side_plank 3x25 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 8m
